title: Free Final Time Adaptive Mesh Covariance Steering via Sequential Convex Programming
summary: In this paper we develop a sequential convex programming (SCP) framework for free-final-time covariance steering of nonlinear stochastic differential equations (SDEs) subject to both additive and multiplicative diffusion. We cast the free-final-time objective through a time-normalization and introduce per-interval time-dilation variables that induce an adaptive discretization mesh, enabling the simultaneous optimization of the control policy and the temporal grid.
